name: Подвійний напад (1)
description:
A double attack is a great trick to attack two things at the same time. With a good double attack you win a piece. 

A double attack can be aimed at:

  • two pieces
  • a piece and the king (give check)
  • a piece and a mating square

What do you have to do?

Win material by attacking two things at the same time.

texts: Try to create two threats at once. Your opponent can only solve one!
